fact: The ICT Backward-Looking Joint Sector Review, convened by MINICT on 22 November 2024, reports progress against NST1/SSP targets for FY2023/24 (for example youth digital literacy of 86.8% against the NST1 target of 100%, and 91% of public services digitised against a 100% target for 2024) and validates the new SSP's theory of change, M&E matrix and implementation plan aligned to NST2.
title: Backward-Looking Joint ICT Sector Review 2023/2024FY
publisher: Ministry of ICT and Innovation (MINICT) / ICT Sector Working Group, via MINECOFIN
